Actions.description:
What happens to a claim that does not stand, by the task's context (an output kind or a document kind);
`default` for any other. A context the contract lists as immutable is never rewritten.

replace_with.description: The caveat a blocked passage gives way to, in a mutable output.
replace_with.title: Replace With

Actions.title: Actions

AgentMemorySettings.description:
The agents' own working notes (10, C). On by default, so a space works with no configuration; a space
turns it off by a diff.

writes.description: `human_only`: an agent's `remember` becomes a proposal a person approves.
writes.title: Writes

AgentMemorySettings.title: AgentMemorySettings

AgentStatePolicy.description:
How an agent's working state of a type is scoped and written. A state is kept whole, with no cap: a
write is bounded only by the request's own size limit, and refused there.
AgentStatePolicy.title: AgentStatePolicy

coverage.description: Counted apart: law and fact never add up.
coverage.title: Coverage

AttributionSettings.description:
Deterministic methods (line, order) and probable ones (identity with the same object in a window, an
assisted handoff) are reported apart, value by band; weights are never summed as money.

handoff_window_days.description: How long after a handoff an outcome that names it counts as assisted by it.
handoff_window_days.title: Handoff Window Days

reconcile_tolerance.description: The deviation from the BI's file past which a report warns.
reconcile_tolerance.title: Reconcile Tolerance

AttributionSettings.title: AttributionSettings

BoundArg.description:
One argument of the tool and the field it carries. `in` and `eq` render to `param`, `not_in` and `ne`
to the negation's, and a comparison or `between` only when `ops` lists it.

transform.description: The case text is sent in.
transform.title: Transform

BoundArg.title: BoundArg

per.description: The scope and period the units count in, `item/1h`.
per.title: Per

BudgetSlice.description:
A share of a purpose's budget for one funnel stage, named by the check's `intent`: spent until it
runs out, or spread evenly over `spread_days`.
BudgetSlice.title: BudgetSlice

mirror.description: The mirror rule: what the customer said themselves, through a confirmed handle of their own, reaches a reader from V1 even when the category asks for more; what the company holds about them (a balance it stated, a record from a system) keeps the category's level. Never applies to a sensitive category.
mirror.title: Mirror

ChannelRule.description:
`free_form_hours` is the service window since the customer's last message (24 on WhatsApp); outside
it, `template_outside_window` says a paid message template is required.
ChannelRule.title: ChannelRule

languages.description: The languages the outputs are in; the first reads a number whose language is unknown.
languages.title: Languages

ClaimEvidence.description: What the turn record must hold for a claim of the category to stand: exactly one kind.

tool.description: A call of this tool in the turn.
tool.title: Tool

ClaimEvidence.title: ClaimEvidence

CommitmentType.description:
How a new commitment of the type meets the ones that hold for the subject: the first holds, the best
(the higher `score`) wins, or an exclusive one holds alone, over every type.
CommitmentType.title: CommitmentType

Compatibility.description:
How a new commitment meets an active one of the same type: the first holds, the best wins, or only
one may exist.
Compatibility.title: Compatibility

ContactBudget.description: Contacts per subject in a rolling window, summed over every agent and vendor of the space.
ContactBudget.title: ContactBudget

ContactKeySettings.description:
The space's contact token key. Raising `generation` rotates it: the new key signs, and the previous
one is still published as `retiring` until `previous_until`, for the tokens it signed to expire.
ContactKeySettings.title: ContactKeySettings

ContextTrimSettings.description:
A leaner pack per agent from what it uses (15.8): a unit of items (kind and category) that a
source was delivered in `min_deliveries` measured deliveries of the last `window_days` days, and never
used, leaves that source's packs. Open items, sensitive items and what the policy releases to the
source's purpose by name never leave.

opt_out_sources.description: Sources that always receive their whole pack.
opt_out_sources.title: Opt Out Sources

ContextTrimSettings.title: ContextTrimSettings

effect_key_days.description: How long an effect key holds, per kind; null holds it for as long as the fact exists.
effect_key_days.title: Effect Key Days

effect_lease_s.description: How long an attempt may stay in flight before it counts as `unknown_outcome`.
effect_lease_s.title: Effect Lease S

DeclaredOperation.description: An operation of the space with what it means, in the company's words and language.
DeclaredOperation.title: DeclaredOperation

DerivedField.description:
A field computed when the object is read, from the related objects of one relation (a look's pieces):
never stored, so it follows every change of a related object at once.

field.description: The related objects' field `min` and `max` compare; only they name one.
field.title: Field

over.description: The relation whose related objects it is computed over.
over.title: Over

where.description: A condition on each related object, in its own type's terms: `count` counts the ones it holds for, `all` and `any` say whether it holds for every one or for some, and `min` and `max` compare only those.
where.title: Where

DerivedField.title: DerivedField

Detect.description:
How a category finds its claims in the text, without a model: numbers of these classes, the words
around them that give their role, terms of the trade, named patterns, or sections of a document.

roles.description: The words that give a number its role, synonyms and every language in one list.
roles.title: Roles

terms.description: With `classes`, a number counts only in a sentence that holds one of them; alone, the term is the claim.
terms.title: Terms

Detect.title: Detect

ElementExperiment.description:
A fixed holdout per person on one element (`element`), on the whole agent (`agent`, negotiated), or the
interleaving of a tool's two rankings (`interleave`, team draft seeded by the turn).

cuped_days.description: Days of outcome history as the covariate; 0 turns CUPED off.
cuped_days.title: Cuped Days

sample.description: The share of turns an interleaving runs on.
sample.title: Sample

section.description: The pack's section, for `pack_section`: the sections whose items a measurement can see.
section.title: Section

ElementExperiment.title: ElementExperiment

exposure_id.description: Absent for an item of no list.
exposure_id.title: Exposure Id

EventAnchor.description:
A kind of system event a customer names in a question ("depois da vistoria", "since the delivery"):
the canonical types it covers (a trailing `*` matches a prefix) and the words for it by language. The
time words around it ("depois de", "antes de", "desde", "after", "before", "since", "después de") are the
product's; the terms are the space's, editable like the rest of its configuration.
EventAnchor.title: EventAnchor

after.description: A duration, or the name of a value holding the deadline.
after.title: After

endpoint_url.description: S3-protocol endpoint of the customer's store; empty means the AWS endpoint of `region`.
endpoint_url.title: Endpoint Url

ExtractionGuidance.description:
The company's words on what extraction should focus on and leave out (5.7). They narrow and focus
the extraction; they never override its rules: evidence for every item, the space's predicates, and
sensitive data only under a sensitive predicate.

exclude.description: Topics to leave out, e.g. `small talk`.
exclude.title: Exclude

include.description: Topics to capture with care, e.g. `delivery windows`.
include.title: Include

sources.description: By source id or source name, like the schema's `source_overrides`.
sources.title: Sources

ExtractionGuidance.title: ExtractionGuidance

operations.description: The space's own operations an open item may wait for, beyond the product's catalog: what its agents record and its systems confirm in `fields.operation` (`file`, `approve`). An item names one so the action or event that does it closes the item, even the first time it happens. Each is a name, or `{name, description}` with what it means in the company's words (`{"name": "file", "description": "protocolar uma peça no processo"}`): the extraction reads the description to tell which operation an item waits for, and without one it names the operation of an item in the company's own words far less often.
operations.title: Operations

FailDirection.description: Which way a purpose's decision goes when Niadra cannot take it.
FailDirection.title: FailDirection

Feature.description:
The agent features of a space (7.7, 24.8): every one is on by default, so a space works with no
configuration; the space's `features` document lists fewer to turn some off, and
`GET /v1/sdk/profile` announces what is on.
Feature.title: Feature

FeatureSettings.description:
The agent features the space has on (7.7, 24.8): their routes and hooks answer only for a feature
listed here. Every feature is on by default, so a space works with no configuration; a space lists fewer
to turn some off.
FeatureSettings.title: FeatureSettings

label.description: The field's name in the space's language, as a text for a model says it (`coparticipação`); the field's own name otherwise.
label.title: Label

Gateway.description:
A dispatch point that checks contact tokens offline. `secret_ref` names, in the space's vault, the
key it shares with Niadra for the token's `rcpt`.
Gateway.title: Gateway

HandoffOutcomeRule.description:
What an outcome the receiving side reports feeds besides the subject's memory: suppressions of the
subject, and interactions its signals take (a preference said to the person who took over).
HandoffOutcomeRule.title: HandoffOutcomeRule

HandoffSettings.description:
`level` is the ownership level a created handoff holds its subject at for the receiving side until
the outcome comes back (None holds nothing); `expected_hours` is when an outcome is due, after which the
handoff is `expired`. `outcomes` is the vocabulary the receiving side reports in, through the API or
through the system events `reported` maps.
HandoffSettings.title: HandoffSettings

IngestMaskingSettings.description:
What ingestion holds back from text before anything is stored (12-AI-MEMORY, WP-A): card numbers
(the last four digits stay), card security codes, passwords and credentials inside URLs. All four by
default; the security team may drop a type, except on the Regulado plan, whose floor always holds.

types.description: Any of `card`, `cvv`, `password`, `secret`. On the Regulado plan `card`, `cvv` and `password` are masked whatever this list says.
types.title: Types

IngestMaskingSettings.title: IngestMaskingSettings

InternalText.description:
Fingerprints of the company's own prompt: hashes of every `n` words, computed by the SDK, never the
prompt itself. An output that repeats one gives way to `redact`, recorded as a claim of the category
`internal_text` with the verdict `internal_text_found`, the action taken and, as evidence, the
`shingle_hashes_ref` in `document`.

shingle_hashes_ref.description: The prompt version the hashes were computed from.
shingle_hashes_ref.title: Shingle Hashes Ref

InternalText.title: InternalText

fingerprint.description: An expression whose value identifies the same observation across sources.
fingerprint.title: Fingerprint

match.description: A pattern per identifier a conversation writes as it is (a case number, an order number), a path of the natural key or a declared field: what the text says in that shape names the customer's own object holding that value, never an object the customer is not tied to.
match.title: Match

LegalBasis.description: The legal bases of LGPD arts. 7 and 11 and GDPR art. 6, by one English name each.
LegalBasis.title: LegalBasis

Mapping.description: A versioned webhook/batch template (5.2): the raw payload is always kept, so it can be remapped.

verification_challenge.description: Query param echoed on GET challenges.
verification_challenge.title: Verification Challenge

Mapping.title: Mapping

anchor_terms.description: Words a customer uses for the event this rule maps (`vistoria`, `inspection`): a question such as "after the inspection" is then read against the customer's latest event of `canonical_type`. Added to the space's `event_anchors`.
anchor_terms.title: Anchor Terms

match.description: JMESPath that must be truthy for this rule to apply.
match.title: Match

priors_by_source.description: Each night, priors per source too: a read by a source smooths affinity toward what that source's people did, where enough of them saw the value, and toward the space's elsewhere.
priors_by_source.title: Priors By Source

revenue.description: Absent: outcomes are counted, and no revenue is attributed.

MediaSettings.description: Text taken from files and images inside the cell, before the redactor (10, D.1). Empty: none.

extract_text_from.description: The types whose text is read, told by the file's bytes: PDF (its text layer, and OCR for scanned pages), JPEG and PNG (OCR), DOCX, XLSX and PPTX. Macro-enabled Office files are never read.
extract_text_from.title: Extract Text From

MediaSettings.title: MediaSettings

MemoryOffCost.description:
What one agent cost per turn with memory off, as the company measured it: the bar a turn with memory
must not rise above (it replaces context and round trips, never adds to them).

agent.description: The agent's name, as its turn records name it.
agent.title: Agent

measured.description: How and when it was measured.
measured.title: Measured

MemoryOffCost.title: MemoryOffCost

MirrorOf.description: The company's system this type mirrors: Niadra mirrors and never is the barrier.

fingerprint.description: The fingerprint of the catalog an introspection read.
fingerprint.title: Fingerprint

MirrorOf.title: MirrorOf

ModelPriceConfig.description: A model's price for the prompt-cache estimate, in USD per million tokens (15.3).
ModelPriceConfig.title: ModelPriceConfig

Natures.description:
How a number is handled by where it came from: computed (a value with provenance in the turn, by rule
or observed) is checked against it; quoted (inside quotation marks) is checked only for being in a source,
as written, even when it is false; said by the model (no origin) takes this action, or the category's.
Natures.title: Natures

param.description: The argument that takes the values the field must not have.
param.title: Param

NegativeCorpus.description:
Phrases of the trade that must never trigger the contract, versioned: `niadra contract test` fails when
one does.
NegativeCorpus.title: NegativeCorpus

ObjectType.description:
One object type: a sale, a lawsuit, a proposal, an item, an agent's working state. Declared by the
company or derived from its schema; every value it describes keeps its source, its observer and its
stamps, and freshness is computed when it is read.

inputs.description: What a derived object is a function of.
inputs.title: Inputs

ObjectType.title: ObjectType

ObjectTypeRegistry.description: The `object-types` document of a space: every type it declared or derived.

commercial_purposes.description: The purposes whose reads are commercial: a source whose licence forbids commercial use never feeds them.
commercial_purposes.title: Commercial Purposes

derived_fields_in_text.description: Whether the state block's lines for the model say the objects' derived fields. A state read carries them either way.
derived_fields_in_text.title: Derived Fields In Text

ObjectTypeRegistry.title: ObjectTypeRegistry

ObservationRule.description:
What a system event of `canonical_type` from the source says: from the event's time, its subject (or
each object it names) is held at `level` by `holder`; without a level, what the source said before ends.
An observation is never refused, and the most restrictive valid claim still decides who holds.
ObservationRule.title: ObservationRule

OutcomeDefinition.description:
An object type whose lifecycle outcome the space measures. Which of its states are provisional and
which final comes from the type's lifecycle; this names the states that count as success, the money they
carry and where the agent's marks are: the exposure token on each line, on the object, or a handoff.

coupon_field.description: The coupon applied to the order as a whole.
coupon_field.title: Coupon Field

final_after.description: The exchange window: a provisional outcome is final this long after it was reached, unless the object reached a final state first.
final_after.title: Final After

handoff_field.description: The id of the handoff that assisted the outcome, for assisted attribution.
handoff_field.title: Handoff Field

lines.description: The object's lines, for attribution by line.

purchase_field.description: The id of the purchase a split order's parts share, for `split_orders`.
purchase_field.title: Purchase Field

revenue_field.description: The object's amount, for an outcome without lines, before discounts, coupon, shipping and taxes.
revenue_field.title: Revenue Field

stamp_field.description: An exposure token on the object itself, for attribution by order.
stamp_field.title: Stamp Field

OutcomeDefinition.title: OutcomeDefinition

OutcomeLines.description:
Where an outcome object keeps its lines, for attribution by line: a list field whose entries carry the
line's id, the item, its value and quantity, its own state, and the exposure token the cart line copied
(the exposure token spec). What a line's size and a return's reason say becomes the subject's size.

failed_states.description: A line in one of these states carries no value: a partial return or cancellation.
failed_states.title: Failed States

replaces.description: The id of the line of the same order it replaced, in an exchange.
replaces.title: Replaces

return_reason.description: The line's return reason: `size_small` and `size_large` say it did not fit.
return_reason.title: Return Reason

size_attribute.description: The subject attribute a kept size becomes: `size.pants`.
size_attribute.title: Size Attribute

stamp.description: The exposure token the cart line carried.
stamp.title: Stamp

state.description: The line's own state, when it differs.
state.title: State

tax.description: The line's tax, outside its amount.
tax.title: Tax

value.description: The line's amount before discounts, coupons, shipping and taxes.
value.title: Value

OutcomeLines.title: OutcomeLines

OwnershipSettings.description:
`levels` go from the most restrictive to the least: a claim at a softer level never demotes a
stricter one still valid. `declaration_max_s` caps a lease declared through the API.
OwnershipSettings.title: OwnershipSettings

OwnershipSource.description:
A source that observes who holds a subject (a service panel through a mapping, a middleware's pause
flag through the worker). `max_validity_s` caps what it states, including what never expires where it
comes from; `levels` are the ones it may state. A mapped source reads the system events of `source_id`
through its `rules`; the worker states its observations through the claims route, naming the source.
OwnershipSource.title: OwnershipSource

PaidBudget.description:
Units a paid operation (a search, a refresh, an expensive call) may spend per object, subject or
space in a rolling window, in the company's units, never in money. An attempt of unknown cost reserves
the highest cost measured for the operation, and a paid call that fails still counts. `max_units_per_call`
is the ceiling of one call.
PaidBudget.title: PaidBudget

compatible_purposes.description: Purpose compatibility (LGPD art. 6 I, GDPR art. 6(4)), written by the client's legal team: an item collected for the key may also be read by an agent working for one of the listed purposes. Unlisted, an item collected for a purpose is read only for that purpose (13, 6.6). The purposes are the ones the `purposes` document declares.
compatible_purposes.title: Compatible Purposes

competes_with.description: source_id -> the partners it must never read, by handle id or by the partner's profile id, which covers the handles the partner gains later (21.5).
competes_with.title: Competes With

about.description: `organization`: a fact about the organization a contact acts for (its e-mail, its business hours), kept as the organization's when the contact has one active link, never as the contact's own.
about.title: About

observes.description: The field of the object's type this predicate is said about (`due_date`): a fact of it about an object is shown next to the value the system of record holds, never in its place, and one that differs opens a data issue of class `divergence`.
observes.title: Observes

Preference.description: What the person wants or refuses, said or captured from a tool's arguments; only these become hard.

category.description: Holds only in this category of the type.
category.title: Category

Preference.title: Preference

Presented.description:
A list delivered to the person: the exposure. Its canonical moment is `delivered_at`, when the
interface bridge handed the list to the client, never when a tool returned it or the model named it.

method.description: `bridge` from the interface bridge, `otel` from a `niadra.exposure` span, `tool_result` inferred from what a tool returned: labeled, because it counts more than was shown.
method.title: Method

page.description: "See more" is the same list with `page + 1`.
page.title: Page

visible_k.description: How many of the first items were visible on delivery.
visible_k.title: Visible K

Presented.title: Presented

pos.description: 1-based position in the whole list, across pages.
pos.title: Pos

shown.description: The values the item showed, for the fields its type tracks or lets be claimed; what `changes_since_seen` later compares against.
shown.title: Shown

team.description: Which of two interleaved lists contributed the item (24.7).
team.title: Team

PurposeRule.description:
A contact purpose. `fail` is what a check answers when Niadra cannot decide; `token` makes an
outbound contact of the purpose need a contact token at the dispatch point, which then refuses it
without one, so a purpose with a token fails closed.
PurposeRule.title: PurposeRule

PurposeSettings.description:
Why each memory item is collected, on which legal basis, and for how long (13, 6.6). Empty: items
carry no purpose and reads, retention and the access package ignore purposes.

An item is tagged when written, by the first rule that names a purpose: its category (a fact's category
or its conversation's normalized category), the canonical types of the system events it came from, the
collecting source's `purposes`, then `default`. Only purposes declared here count.

categories.description: Fact category or conversation category -> the purposes it is collected for.
categories.title: Categories

default.description: Purposes of an item no other rule names. Empty leaves such items without a purpose, readable by every reader; the Console counts them so the map can be completed.
default.title: Default

event_types.description: Canonical event type (a trailing `*` matches a prefix) -> the purposes of what it brings: facts and promises whose evidence includes such an event.
event_types.title: Event Types

PurposeSettings.title: PurposeSettings

PurposeSpec.description:
One purpose the company processes customer data for, with its legal basis and how long it keeps
what it collects for it.

retention_days.description: Days an item collected for this purpose is kept after it was last confirmed (a fact), ended (a conversation, a value) or closed (a promise). Empty: the purpose sets no limit.
retention_days.title: Retention Days

PurposeSpec.title: PurposeSpec

Purposes.description: What a read with each purpose does with stale data: the read itself never refuses.
Purposes.title: Purposes

QuietHours.description:
Local times, in the space's timezone unless `timezone` says otherwise. A contact inside them is
deferred to their end, never dropped.
QuietHours.title: QuietHours

content_mode.description: Where the recorded values of a source without its own line live: `stored` in Niadra, encrypted; `pointer` in the company's storage, with only pointers and digests sent; `hash_only` nowhere, only digests. A source may always send a mode that lets less in.
content_mode.title: Content Mode

kept_days.description: The retention of turn recordings, in days: a turn older than this goes, in every tier. Unset, a recording is kept until an erasure removes it.
kept_days.title: Kept Days

pii_model.description: After the rules, the PII model also reads the text of the tools' arguments in `stored` records, and the values it finds are replaced in the record.
pii_model.title: Pii Model

required_pins.description: The pins a turn needs to be replayable; a turn without one is kept, marked not replayable.
required_pins.title: Required Pins

sample_rate.description: The share of conversations the kept tier takes whole, besides the flagged turns and the ones promoted on request.
sample_rate.title: Sample Rate

scenario_days.description: How long a replay scenario keeps its turns after it last ran. Unset, they are kept until an erasure removes them.
scenario_days.title: Scenario Days

unconfirmed_watch.description: A watch whose condition holds on a value that did not come live from its source asks the resolver worker for the value again (`watch_revalidation`, on the `interest_alert` budget). When none comes (no worker, the budget refused, the worker released it or gave up), the watch fires with `revalidated: false`, or is dropped.
unconfirmed_watch.title: Unconfirmed Watch

never_money.description: Budgets are in the company's units, never in money.
never_money.title: Never Money

match.description: A reverse relation: the related objects are the customers' objects of `type` whose field of this name holds the value at `via` (a lawsuit's notices by its `case_number`).
match.title: Match

via.description: The path in this object's state to the related objects' ids; with `match`, to the value they name this object by.
via.title: Via

ReportedOutcome.description:
A system event of the receiving side that reports a handoff's outcome without calling the API: a
ticket closed as solved, a sale won. The event names the handoff by an object reference of type `handoff`
or by its field `handoff_field`.
ReportedOutcome.title: ReportedOutcome

ResultObjects.description: Where a result carries objects of a type, and which key of each item holds which field.

id.description: The key of the item that holds the object's id.
id.title: Id

ResultObjects.title: ResultObjects

RevenueDefinition.description:
Signed with the company, line by line: without it the number never matches its BI. A line's value is
its amount before discounts, coupons, shipping and taxes; these settings say which of them it takes in.

basis.description: `net_of_discount` takes the line's discount and the coupon off; `gross` takes neither.
basis.title: Basis

cancellations.description: `by_line`: a line in a failed state (a partial cancellation or return) is worth nothing; `whole_order`: only the order's own state takes its value.
cancellations.title: Cancellations

coupons.description: `prorated_by_line` spreads the order's coupon over its lines by their value; `order_level` leaves the lines whole and takes it off the order's own value only.
coupons.title: Coupons

exchanges.description: A line that names the line it replaced: `new_item` is a line of its own, and the replaced one follows its own state; `same_item` is the same sale, so the replaced line keeps its value and the replacing one counts nothing.
exchanges.title: Exchanges

shipping.description: `included` spreads the order's shipping over its lines by their value.
shipping.title: Shipping

split_orders.description: `by_seller`: each seller's part of a split purchase is its own order; `whole_order`: the parts that name the same purchase count, and reconcile, as one order.
split_orders.title: Split Orders

taxes.description: `included` adds each line's tax, and the order's own to an order without lines.
taxes.title: Taxes

RevenueDefinition.title: RevenueDefinition

novelty.description: A revision of the same observation keeps the time Niadra first knew of it.
novelty.title: Novelty

Seen.description: A ping of the list component: how far the person saw.
Seen.title: Seen

SequentialTest.description:
A mixture sequential probability ratio test (mSPRT): looked at every day without inflating the false
positives.

mixing_variance.description: The spread of the effects the test expects, in units of one person's variance: 0.01 expects differences of about a tenth of a standard deviation. Any value keeps the false positives within `alpha`; one close to the true effect decides sooner.
mixing_variance.title: Mixing Variance

SequentialTest.title: SequentialTest

critical.description: Critical sources never join a control group (19.7).
critical.title: Critical

SourceGuidance.description:
What one source's conversations add to the space's guidance: its instructions come after the
space's, and its topics join the space's lists.
SourceGuidance.title: SourceGuidance

sources.description: The sources whose agents call it; empty, every one.
sources.title: Sources

SpaceLimits.description: What the tenant's contract sets for a space; the control plane fills it from the tenant's quotas.

llm_daily_micros.description: Daily AI spend ceiling per purpose (`extraction`, `assistant`).
llm_daily_micros.title: Llm Daily Micros

SpaceLimits.title: SpaceLimits

SuppressionReason.description:
Why a subject is not to be contacted for a purpose; `resume_after_hours` lifts the suppression on its
own, and None keeps it until someone lifts it.
SuppressionReason.title: SuppressionReason

SynonymGroup.description:
Words and phrases a customer uses for one thing ("senha", "passcode", "código de acceso"), by
language, and the episode categories that thing is evidence of. The lexical slot channel and the count
line read a turn and a memory line through these groups, without a model.
SynonymGroup.title: SynonymGroup

TaskView.description: A task view (`task:<name>`), or the space's own `custom` view, one per space.

include_agent_memory.description: Appends up to 200 tokens of the agent's own notes tagged with the view's object types, for agents whose prompt cannot change (10, C.3).
include_agent_memory.title: Include Agent Memory

template.description: The layout of the customer block: text with section names in braces (`{facts}`, `{pending}`, `{episodes}`...), nothing else; `{{` and `}}` write a brace. The opening line and the tags around the block stay.
template.title: Template

TaskView.title: TaskView

model_prices.description: Prices keyed `provider/model` for the estimate of the agents' prompt-cache savings, over the product's table of the Claude and OpenAI models it knows.
model_prices.title: Model Prices

prewarm_per_minute.description: Customers whose history says they come back by voice within 72 hours of a contact on another channel get their voice context warmed in the read process before the call, at most this many loads per minute in the space. 0 turns it off.
prewarm_per_minute.title: Prewarm Per Minute

retention_days.description: Days kept per tenant-tunable data class (5.14.0, 22.5), e.g. `cold_events: 730`; unset classes keep the default. `facts`, `episodes`, `open_items` (resolved ones), `receipts` (30 days at least), `sessions` (30 days at least), `raw_content` (payloads as they came, media and raw interactions; 7 days at least) and `cold_events` (the company's events in the cold archive) are kept until set.
retention_days.title: Retention Days

target_model_floors.description: Cache floors keyed `provider/model` or `provider`, over the product's table of the Claude, OpenAI and Gemini models it knows (15.3).
target_model_floors.title: Target Model Floors

TimeAxes.description: Named time axes: each key other than `timers_on` is an axis.
TimeAxes.title: TimeAxes

due.description: When it fires: a date or a datetime on the `timers_on` axis.
due.title: Due

dry_run_param.description: The argument that makes a call change nothing, for a counterfactual.
dry_run_param.title: Dry Run Param

mask_output.description: The SDK masks the fields the key may not read in the tool's output.
mask_output.title: Mask Output

overfetch.description: The tool returns more than asked: the SDK filters the residual from it.
overfetch.title: Overfetch

relax_flag.description: Where the result says the tool relaxed what it was asked.
relax_flag.title: Relax Flag

ValueEvidence.description: A value in the turn record, from a tool's result or from state, that the number is checked against.

fresh_for.description: The value is within its type's `claim_max_age`, or the claim is `stale`.
fresh_for.title: Fresh For

gap_terms.description: The words that state each declared gap; a gap without them is stated by its name.
gap_terms.title: Gap Terms

must_state_gaps.description: The value's declared gaps must be said with it, or `gap_not_stated`.
must_state_gaps.title: Must State Gaps

same_role.description: The value's role is the number's role.
same_role.title: Same Role

value.description: A field or a computed value of `type`.
value.title: Value

ValueEvidence.title: ValueEvidence

ValueSpec.description: A value the company computes and Niadra keeps as a versioned fact: the rule stays the company's.

absent_as.description: The name the value takes when it is absent.
absent_as.title: Absent As

ValueSpec.title: ValueSpec

Verification.description: Session verification levels (2.2). `no_customer` sits outside the V0-V4 scale.
Verification.title: Verification

Watch.description: An explicit "let me know when": the only way an interest raises a notice.

condition.description: A `niadra-expr` expression over the object's fields.
condition.title: Condition

Watch.title: Watch

authorization_ref.description: A secret sent as the Authorization header, e.g. `Splunk <token>` for a collector.
authorization_ref.title: Authorization Ref

event_types.description: Event types for a `standard` endpoint; receipt kinds (`read`, `history`, `denied`, `admin`, `analytics`, `holdout`) or `*` for a SIEM stream.
event_types.title: Event Types

format.description: `standard`: Standard Webhooks events (7.5). `ocsf` and `hec`: the receipts stream to a SIEM, as OCSF API Activity events one per line, or wrapped for an HTTP Event Collector (5.13).
format.title: Format

source_id.description: The endpoint belongs to a source, whose audience limits the payload.
source_id.title: Source Id

niadra__contracts__signals__Attribute.description:
What the person is: a size, a preferred network, a diet. Said here; the lifecycle's outcomes (bought,
kept, returned for size) derive the rest on the server, never an agent.
niadra__contracts__signals__Attribute.title: Attribute

description: Everything a cell needs to serve one space.

claim_contract.description: Without a declaration: dates and amounts checked against the turn record and counted.

event_anchors.description: The system events a question can be anchored on, with the words for each.
event_anchors.title: Event Anchors

instance.description: The cell's database instance, by name, that holds the space's database; absent for the cell's own instance (`primary`).
instance.title: Instance

kms_key_arn.description: The customer's key in KMS, set by the contract, never by a diff.
kms_key_arn.title: Kms Key Arn

limits.description: Set by the contract, never by a diff.

purposes.description: Without a declaration: one purpose, `service`, on the contract basis, kept 730 days.

synonyms.description: Words that mean the same thing to this space's customers, by language.
synonyms.title: Synonyms

tier.description: The database tier the cell creates the space's database with, set by placement: t1 on an instance of its own, t2 on a cell dedicated to the tenant. Absent for t0, the shared instance.
tier.title: Tier

title: SpaceConfig
